images.scene: Robinson wedged in the fork of a large tree at night, clinging to a branch as rain pours down, keeping himself off the ground for fear of wild creatures on the dark island.
images.alt: A man sleeps up in the branches of a tree at night while it rains.

images.scene: Robinson poling a makeshift wooden raft loaded with chests, boards and salvaged supplies across the shallow water from the stranded ship toward the island beach.
images.alt: A man steers a loaded raft of salvaged goods from a wreck toward the shore.

images.scene: Robinson pitching his canvas tent in a semicircular clearing at the foot of a tall rock face, with chests and timber forming a rough fence around the new encampment.
images.alt: A man sets up a tent and fence at the base of a large rock.

images.scene: Robinson kneeling beside a young goat, binding and splinting its broken leg with sticks and string outside his shelter, the tamed animal calm beside him.
images.alt: A man kneels to splint the broken leg of a young goat.

images.scene: Robinson crouching in astonishment beside the rock wall of his enclosure, staring at a small clump of green barley stalks with ripening ears sprouting unexpectedly from the bare ground.
images.alt: A man crouches in surprise before green barley growing out of the ground by a rock.

images.scene: Robinson scrambling over his wooden pile wall onto open ground as the earthquake shakes the hillside, loose earth crumbling from the cave roof and a great rock crashing down in the distance by the sea.
images.alt: A man climbs over a wall to flee as an earthquake shakes the hillside and a rock falls.
